scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm run test:browser-db --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client && npm run build:pages --prefix client
scripts.e2e: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build:pages --prefix client && node --test --test-concurrency=1 e2e/local.e2e.mjs e2e/pages.e2e.mjs
scripts.e2e:ci: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build:pages --prefix client && node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=e2e-report.xml e2e/local.e2e.mjs e2e/pages.e2e.mjs
scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
